note: Acceptance walks for Leffe's navigation maps: what they add over our grid in city interiors, caves and mines, multi-floor buildings, lifts and choke points. Every walk is a pair of ends our guides walk (consecutive goals of the v1 goal streams, or two guide-placed ends a step's text walks between), with the faction profile that walks it.

Format as tools/lib/nav/eval/acceptance.json routes: ends are world [x, y, z|null] in the UnitPosition frame (z from the NPC's spawn when known, else from an object or NPC spawn within 1.5 yd of the goal, else null); map 0 Eastern Kingdoms, 1 Kalimdor; tags are a category (city, cave, floors, chokepoint, lift) plus place names; outcome is what a correct walk does; source is the guide file:line pair and the goal indices in that v1 stream.
Run together with the 46 walks of acceptance.json listed under include (by id, not copied).
